description:
Seeking offers in excess of €849,000

An exceptional architect-designed residence set on a low-maintenance site in a highly sought-after location approximately 3km from Wexford Town Centre.

Extending to approximately 177 sq m, this superb A-rated home is presented in immaculate, turnkey condition and offers an impressive standard of finish throughout. Thoughtfully designed with modern living in mind, the property features a bespoke, beautifully appointed kitchen, luxurious bathroom suites, elegant interiors and a wonderful sense of style and quality throughout.

The low-maintenance exterior further enhances the appeal of this exceptional home, providing an ideal balance of sophistication, comfort and practicality.  The location is equally impressive; the property is within easy walking distance of Kaat Strand and the River Slaney, while the renowned Curracloe Beach is less than a 10-minute drive away. Wexford Town, with its extensive range of shops, restaurants, cafés, schools and amenities, is also conveniently close by.

Rarely does a home of this calibre, combining architectural design, A-rated energy efficiency, exceptional finishes and such a desirable coastal setting, come to the market. A truly unique opportunity to acquire a distinctive contemporary residence, ready for immediate occupation. 

Early viewing is highly recommended.
